correctness.rationale: For C_n square K_2, n>=3, the cubic outside-neighbor P3-convex condition on S is equivalent to every vertex of the complement T having induced degree at least two. Four two-bit column states and a 16-pair transfer automaton characterize precisely every cyclic column word and its complement size, with no rotation quotient. The six acyclic transfer states contribute no determinant factors; independent exact SymPy polynomial determinant on the ten active states reproduced det(I-zM)=(1-yz+y^3z^2)*[1-(1+y+y^2)z+(y+y^2)z^2-(y^4+y^5)z^3+2y^5z^4+y^7z^5] with 18 monomials. The formal log-determinant identity then proves the all-n trace generating function. Independent graph-level brute force matched full cardinality polynomials for n=3..8 (total 13,32,69,157,361,824), and transfer checks for n=10..18 reproduce the claimed first ten coefficients; finite checks corroborate, rather than replace, the transfer and determinant. Perron-Frobenius for the primitive active component yields lambda~2.31240391. No arbitrary cubic-graph enumeration is asserted.
